PIONEER_HYPOTHESIS.description: New theory created from gap detection with minimal prior confidence.

PROVISIONAL.description: Theory has some support but remains domain-local and non-canonical.

RIVAL.description: Theory exists in active competition with one or more alternatives.

CANONICAL_CANDIDATE.description: Theory has survived synthesis review and is awaiting doctrine-level promotion.

CANONICAL.description: Theory is part of the official worldview.

SUBSUMED.description: Theory remains historically valid but is now represented by a broader model.

DEPRECATED.description: Theory is retained historically but no longer used actively.

REJECTED.description: Theory failed bounded evaluation and should not be used in research or doctrine.
